input.rationale: This is clearly a motor vehicle collision claim involving significant vehicle damage (totaled vehicle) and personal injury (whiplash and sprained wrist) from a rear-end accident, covered under the auto policy.

The vehicle is totaled with severe structural damage (trunk crushed into back seat), and the claimant sustained personal injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist) from a high-impact collision; total loss vehicle claims typically exceed policy deductibles significantly.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003, auto full coverage, $750 deductible, $100,000 limit, active status) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday at a red light. The other vehicle struck claimant's vehicle at approximately 35 mph without braking, totaling the vehicle with severe structural damage (trunk crushed into back seat). Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. Claim classified as auto with 0.95 confidence and high severity due to total loss vehicle and documented personal injuries.
